FTC Act s5, 15 U.S.C. 45 (unfairness)

us_status: in force as amended (17 U.S.C. 119, last extended by the Satellite Television Community Protection and Promotion Act of 2019)

Satellite Television Community Protection and Promotion Act of 2019
